'—'`) verified — a legacy history item seeded via localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', <double-JSON>) with NO imageInfo now opens /result?id=<id> WITHOUT a red screen; the resolution area renders as '—'; more-info-card shows with both `Take a closer photo` and `Add symptoms and history`; both reanalyze-history and reanalyze-photos buttons are visible & tappable. shot-label-<i> testIDs added and verified in enhanced mode (shot-label-0='Main / front view', shot-label-1='Left-angle view'). PDF share/download works (real %PDF file downloaded — AiDerma-Report-January-5-2026.pdf). About shows Version 1.0.4. Refresh keeps user on Home. FAB → /assessment renders mode-quick + mode-enhanced; quick-upload-photo reaches improve step with analyze-btn 'Skip & Analyze'. On-device quality gate rejects a 100x100 JPEG with 'That photo is too small to assess…' and thumb count does not increase. FAIL — NEW HIGH BUG (same family as iteration-10 result.tsx:103, now surviving in capture.tsx:216): re-analyzing ANY legacy HistoryItem missing imageInfo throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading resolution)' inside capture.tsx analyze() line 216, because shotFromStored() rebuilds legacy images with width:0/height:0, so `first.width` is falsy and code falls through to `existing?.imageInfo.resolution` where existing.imageInfo is undefined → red-screen (shown as capture-error toast). This blocks BOTH reanalyze-history and reanalyze-photos flows end-to-end for legacy cases; the new-scan path is unaffected because capture.tsx always writes imageInfo on new saves. Because of this crash we could not verify (a) same-id no-duplicate persistence, (b) Information Used populated with 2 history labels, or (c) Information Used '2 clinical photographs' for reanalyze-photos — those remain UNVERIFIED for legacy cases. No Expo/React-Native deprecated-package issues detected in the touched surfaces. No changes made by testing agent (report-only).

ui_bugs.issue: Line 216 reads `existing?.imageInfo.resolution` (non-defensive on `.imageInfo`). shotFromStored() sets width:0/height:0 for restored legacy images (lines 70/73), so `first.width` evaluates falsy on any legacy case; execution falls through to `existing?.imageInfo.resolution` which throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'resolution')` whenever existing.imageInfo is undefined (i.e. every legacy/seeded case, or a case created before the imageInfo field existed). This crashes BOTH reanalyze-history and reanalyze-photos before the AI call completes and blocks case-identity persistence checks. Fix: `existing?.imageInfo?.resolution ?? '—'` (add the missing optional chain). Reference: /app/frontend/app/capture.tsx:216

critical_code_review_comments: result.tsx:103 correctly uses optional chaining now — legacy items render '—' cleanly.

capture.tsx:216 misses the same optional chain on the fallback branch: `existing?.imageInfo.resolution ?? '—'` should be `existing?.imageInfo?.resolution ?? '—'`. The trailing `?? '—'` only guards a `null/undefined` return from `.resolution`, not the property access itself.

capture.tsx shotFromStored() returns width:0/height:0 for restored images, which combined with the missing optional chain forces every legacy re-analyze into the crashing branch. Preserving the original resolution (e.g. from existing.imageInfo) would also fix the visible '—' resolution pill after a legacy re-analyze.

rca_of_issue: Bug (iteration 11, HIGH): `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'resolution')` surfaces via the capture screen's `capture-error` toast whenever the user re-analyzes a legacy HistoryItem missing `imageInfo`. Root cause is in /app/frontend/app/capture.tsx:216 — the code writes `imageInfo.resolution: first.width ? `${first.width} x ${first.height}px` : (existing?.imageInfo.resolution ?? '—')`. For a restored legacy case, `shotFromStored()` (lines 67-75) sets width/height to 0, so `first.width` is falsy; execution therefore evaluates `existing?.imageInfo.resolution`, which is `undefined.resolution` when `existing.imageInfo` is missing, throwing before the nullish-coalesce is reached. Repro: (a) login as test1@example.com / secret123; (b) `localStorage.setItem('diagnosis_history', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify([itemWithoutImageInfo])))`; (c) hard-reload; (d) open /result?id=<id>; (e) tap reanalyze-history (or reanalyze-photos + add a photo); (f) tap analyze-btn — the toast appears and the /result redirect never happens. Fix: add the missing optional chain — replace `existing?.imageInfo.resolution` with `existing?.imageInfo?.resolution` on capture.tsx:216. This is a one-character change and does not touch any business logic. Not applicable to new scans because capture.tsx always writes imageInfo on first save. See also action_items for an optional but recommended shotFromStored() improvement to preserve original width/height on restore.
